claims.text: The Ed25519 signature in SIGNATURE.sig verifies over the raw bytes of RESULTS.json followed by MANIFEST.json under PUBLIC_KEY.pem.
The S6 seal verifies as an Ed25519 signature over the raw 32-byte S5 root under PUBLIC_KEY.pem.
Every S4 entry (name, SHA-256, byte count) recomputes from the pinned evidence fixture, in declared order.
The S5 root, leaf count and every published level recompute from the S4 digests under the documented rule (nti-s5-leaf-v1: and nti-s5-node-v1: prefixes, odd node promoted).
Every file listed in MANIFEST.json is pinned and has the listed SHA-256.
The GitHub Pages source docs/witness carries byte-identical copies of the signed package files and of every file it shares with conformance/witness.
The suite outcomes in RESULTS.json (33 Rust and 2 Python tests passed) are evidenced by material in the pinned package beyond the producer's signature.
The Ed25519 key that signs the package is anchored outside the repository whose content it signs.

independence_statement: The checks in verifier/nti_witness.py were written by the runner from the pinned README, after reading the producer's verify.sh and generate_seals.py; no producer code is imported or executed and Ed25519 is the runner's own RFC 8032 implementation. Because the producer's code was read first, this is labelled SECOND_IMPLEMENTATION, not INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION.

probes.remediation: Implement the documented rule in generate_seals.py and verify.sh (promote the odd node, which equals the RFC 6962 split), and commit vectors for leaf counts 1, 3, 5, 6 and 7 that both must pass.

runner_assessment.rationale: A witness following the README and one following verify.sh disagree for every package whose leaf count is not a power of two. The published four-leaf package is unaffected.

probes.remediation: Fix the odd-node rule as above and put the leaf count inside the signed S6 message.

runner_assessment.rationale: Under the implemented rule two different evidence lists can share one root and one seal; this is the CVE-2012-2459 pattern. It needs an odd leaf count to matter, which the published package does not have.

runner_assessment.rationale: The seal is portable: on its own it vouches for a root, not for what the root is said to cover, including the SYNTHETIC classification.
